_comment: Single source for the Control Panel (Game Metadata Manager). Run: python3 tools/bga.py gmm <slug>
description:
Pent-Up is a tile-stacking game for two players with pentomino-shaped tiles. Each player has the 12 different pentominoes of their colour (white or black). Players take turns placing a tile either on the table next to a tile already there, or on top of at least two tiles, always lying flat and fully supported.

The key rule: a tile must go on the highest level where it can legally be placed. When all tiles are placed, the player with the most tiles on the highest level wins; ties go to the next level down.
